#!/usr/bin/env bash
# DWA ingredients only: token-weight policies, path-enumerated/finite-difference Soft-DTW CPU8 and small reference cost.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
PY=/home/uranus/miniforge3/envs/tlm_torch/bin/python
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""
exec "${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 101 --name P106B_Stage7aoW_dwa_ingredients_cpu -- "${PY}" -B -X utf8 -m scripts.diag_p106b_dwa_reference
